role: 크기가 다른 종이풍등 세 개와 대나무 갈비·별지도 기구를 묶은 야간 소품.
motion_ko: 세 풍등이 서로 다른 높이와 리듬으로 천천히 떠 있습니다.
units: Relative art units; not approved engine meters
limits: Visual prototype: collider, LOD, weather rules, bird AI, interaction and gameplay integration are not implemented.
Baked vertex color and actual geometry are saved in GLB; outline and display modes belong to the review viewer.
Animation is keyed mesh/group transformation; fluid simulation, cloth simulation and skeletal bird rig are not included.
